summary: NIP Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting an ADS ratio change effective July 6, 2026, from 1 ADS:2 Class A ordinary shares to 1 ADS:60 Class A ordinary shares, equivalent to a 1-for-30 reverse ADS split. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. Citibank acts as depositary; fractional entitlements will be sold for cash. This is a routine corporate action to adjust the ADS trading price, not a special situation. There is no event to watch beyond the effective date.
